_note: UNVERIFIED first guesses. Confirm each one against the real app with tools/map_screen.py. Each list is tried in order; every entry is a uiautomator2 selector (description, descriptionMatches, text, textMatches, resourceId, resourceIdMatches, className, ...). *Matches values are Java regexes that must match the whole string.

discover._verified: 2026-10-09 on Pixel 7 / Android 14: like buttons are Buttons described 'Like photo' etc., skip is 'Skip <name>'. The space after 'like' keeps the 'Likes You' tab out.
discover._note_chrome: Descriptions on the Discover screen that belong to Hinge itself, not the profile. Left out of the text skip_keywords is checked against, so a keyword like 'height' can't match the 'Height filter options' chip.

nav._note: Bottom tab bar. The layout doesn't say which tab is selected, so the bot just taps Discover when it isn't on the feed.

like_sheet._verified: 2026-10-09: the comment box is a custom view described 'Edit comment' (no EditText); the keyboard types into it. Once text is in the box, 'Send like' becomes 'Send like with message' (and the Rose button 'Send a Rose with message'), so match exactly to never hit the Rose. There's no close button, and Back is unreliable (an extra one leaves Hinge), so the bot never closes the sheet itself: it either sends or stops.
like_sheet._verified_hingex: 2026-10-14 after upgrading to HingeX: the button is 'Send priority like', and 'Send priority like with message' once text is in the box (Rose: 'Send a Rose with message'). The plain 'Send like' labels are kept as fallbacks.

popups_to_dismiss.name: Remove/Report menu
popups_to_dismiss._note: Opens when a tap lands on a profile's 'More' button. Back closes it.
